item.title: Yoga for Every_Body
item.description:
Monday, August 10, 2026 7:30—8:30 PM

Children's Program Room - Ground Floor
The Salem Public Library
370 Essex St, Salem, MA, 01970

Join Olivia in this energizing yoga flow intended for all levels of experience. Experienced and new students alike are welcome! The foundation of each class will be poses that are accessible for every body. Modifications will be offered to make each pose more challenging or gentler on joints and muscles. 

Each class will begin with a gentle warm up and move into learning or revisiting yoga poses. Focus will be on alignment and breathing. Then we will move into an energizing flow matching breath and movement as one. We will end the class with the final pose: a 3 minute savasana where you will let the magic of the physical movement do its work on your mind. You'll leave this class feeling grounded but energized.   Come see what yoga is all about! 

Note: there are many different styles and lineages of yoga. This class will focus on poses and flow. With more or less explanation depending on the students and their prior knowledge of yoga.

What to wear? Wear comfortable clothing that lets you move - maybe even past your normal range of motion. Traditional yoga clothes are not required!

Do I need a yoga mat? Yes and props if you have them. 

What if I don't have a yoga mat or props? We have a limited number of mats that you can borrow for the class. Please mention this in the sign up form so we can keep track of how many are needed. 


For Adults (18+)

*Please register for each week you plan to attend*

Register online between 6/29/2026 9:00 AM and 8/10/2026 10:15 PM.

item.title: Pequeña Raíces
item.description:
Saturday, August 22, 2026 12:00—1:00 PM

Children's Play Area
The Salem Public Library
370 Essex St, Salem, MA, 01970

Pequeñas Raíces es un encuentro mensual, cálido e informal, que se celebra en la Biblioteca Pública de Salem y ha sido creado especialmente para familias y/o niños de habla hispana (Español). Es un espacio para conectar con otras personas y celebrar el idioma y la cultura a través de la conversación y la construcción de comunidad. Ya sea que busquen conocer a otras familias, ayudar a sus hijos a mantener su conexión con el español o simplemente disfrutar de un ambiente acogedor, ¡les damos la bienvenida! 

Pequeñas Raíces is a warm, informal monthly gathering at the Salem Public Library created especially for Spanish-speaking families and/or children. It’s a space to connect with others and celebrate language and culture through conversation and community-building. Whether you’re looking to meet other families, help your child stay connected to Spanish, or simply enjoy a welcoming environment, we welcome you!
